INSERT INTO /* LGVATTCOMM.createExcelAllApprovalPermission */ XXLGE_EXPORT_INFO (SESSION_ID, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, SEQ_NO, CHARACTER_SET_NAME , ATTRIBUTE1, ATTRIBUTE2, ATTRIBUTE3, ATTRIBUTE4, ATTRIBUTE5 , ATTRIBUTE6, ATTRIBUTE7, ATTRIBUTE8, ATTRIBUTE9, ATTRIBUTE10 , ATTRIBUTE11 )
SELECT #{sessionId} AS SESSION_ID , #{sessionUserId} AS CREATED_BY , SYSDATE AS CREATION_DATE , ROWNUM+1 AS ORDER_BY , 'KO16KSC5602' AS CHARACTER_SET_NAME , TO_CHAR(ROWNUM) AS ROWNO , 'Employee No' AS "Employee No" , 'Activity' AS "Activity" , 'User Function Name' AS "User Function Name" , 'Role Name' AS "Role Name" , 'Role End Date' AS "Role End Date" , 'Employee ID' AS "Employee ID" /* 컬럼값이 확인 안됨 */ , 'User Name' AS "User Name" , 'Title' AS "Title" , 'Position' AS "Position" , 'Test Result' AS "Test Result" FROM DUAL UNION ALL select #{sessionId} AS SESSION_ID , #{sessionUserId} AS CREATED_BY , SYSDATE AS CREATION_DATE , ROWNUM+1 AS ORDER_BY , 'KO16KSC5602' AS CHARACTER_SET_NAME , TO_CHAR(ROWNUM) AS ROWNO, u.user_name as "Employee No", mm.SYSTEM_CODE || ' ' || mm.MODULE_CODE AS "Activity", MENU_DESC AS "User Function Name", ur.role_code AS "Role Name", TO_CHAR(NVL(ur.APPLY_END_DATE, TO_DATE('30/12/9999', 'DD/MM/YYYY')), 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS "Role End Date", u.user_name AS "Employee ID", u.LOCAL_LANGUAGE_FULL_NAME AS "User Name", u.GRADE_TITLE_NAME AS "Title", u.POSITION_NAME AS "Position", CASE WHEN POSITION_NAME IS NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Test Result" from lgcom_menu_m mm, lgcom_role_menu_n rm, lgcom_user_role_n ur, lgcom_user_m u where 1 = 1 and rm.menu_id = mm.menu_id and rm.role_code = ur.role_code and ur.application_user_id = u.application_user_id and DISPLAY_FLAG = 'Y' and USE_FLAG = 'Y' and MENU_NAME LIKE '%Approval%' and HIGH_MENU_ID = 'M_LGVATT_1038' and NVL(ur.APPLY_END_DATE, TO_DATE('30/12/9999', 'DD/MM/YYYY')) > TO_DATE(#{timeAndAttendancdYyyymm},'DD/MM/YYYY') and ur.role_code IN ('VN_ORG_MANAGER', 'VN_UNIT_LEADER_USER')

INSERT INTO /* LGVATTCOMM.createExcelAllHRMPermission */ XXLGE_EXPORT_INFO (SESSION_ID, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, SEQ_NO, CHARACTER_SET_NAME , ATTRIBUTE1, ATTRIBUTE2, ATTRIBUTE3, ATTRIBUTE4, ATTRIBUTE5 , ATTRIBUTE6, ATTRIBUTE7, ATTRIBUTE8, ATTRIBUTE9 )
SELECT #{sessionId} AS SESSION_ID , #{sessionUserId} AS CREATED_BY , SYSDATE AS CREATION_DATE , ROWNUM+1 AS ORDER_BY , 'KO16KSC5602' AS CHARACTER_SET_NAME , TO_CHAR(ROWNUM) AS ROWNO , 'Role Name' AS "Role Name" , 'Role End Date' AS "Role End Date" , 'User Name' AS "User Name" , 'Title' AS "Title" , 'Position' AS "Position" , 'Job Group' AS "Job Group" , 'Job Detail' AS "Job Detail" , 'Test Result' AS "Test Result" FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT #{sessionId} AS SESSION_ID , #{sessionUserId} AS CREATED_BY , SYSDATE AS CREATION_DATE , ROWNUM+1 AS ORDER_BY , 'KO16KSC5602' AS CHARACTER_SET_NAME , TO_CHAR(ROWNUM) AS ROWNO, ur.role_code AS "Role Name", TO_CHAR(NVL(ur.APPLY_END_DATE, TO_DATE('31/12/9999', 'DD/MM/YYYY')), 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS "Role End Date", u.LOCAL_LANGUAGE_FULL_NAME AS "User Name", u.GRADE_TITLE_NAME AS "Title", u.POSITION_NAME AS "Position", em.job_group AS "Job Group", em.job_detail AS "Job Detail", CASE WHEN em.job_group = 'HR' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS "Test Result" from lgcom_user_role_n ur, vhr_mgr.lgcom_user_m u, emp_master em where 1 = 1 and ur.role_code IN ('VN_ATT_HR_PIC', 'VN_ATT_MASTER_USER', 'VN_PAY_MASTER_USER', 'VN_PAY_SYSTEM_MASTER_USER') and em.status != 'Terminate Assignment' and ur.application_user_id = u.application_user_id and u.user_name = em.employee_number and NVL(ur.APPLY_END_DATE, TO_DATE('31/12/9999', 'DD/MM/YYYY')) > TO_DATE(#{timeAndAttendancdYyyymm}, 'DD/MM/YYYY')

INSERT INTO /* LGVATTCOMM.createExcelVNATTFSEUSER */ XXLGE_EXPORT_INFO (SESSION_ID, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, SEQ_NO, CHARACTER_SET_NAME , ATTRIBUTE1, ATTRIBUTE2, ATTRIBUTE3, ATTRIBUTE4, ATTRIBUTE5 , ATTRIBUTE6, ATTRIBUTE7, ATTRIBUTE8, ATTRIBUTE9, ATTRIBUTE10 )
SELECT #{sessionId} AS SESSION_ID , #{sessionUserId} AS CREATED_BY , SYSDATE AS CREATION_DATE , ROWNUM+1 AS ORDER_BY , 'KO16KSC5602' AS CHARACTER_SET_NAME , TO_CHAR(ROWNUM) AS ROWNO , 'Role Name' AS "Role Name" , 'Role End Date' AS "Role End Date" , 'User ID' AS "User ID" , 'User Name' AS "User Name" , 'Title' AS "Title" , 'Position' AS "Position" , 'FSE Flag' AS "FSE Flag" , 'Supporter Flag' AS "Supporter Flag" , 'Test Result' AS "Test Result" FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT #{sessionId} AS SESSION_ID , #{sessionUserId} AS CREATED_BY , SYSDATE AS CREATION_DATE , ROWNUM+1 AS ORDER_BY , 'KO16KSC5602' AS CHARACTER_SET_NAME , TO_CHAR(ROWNUM) AS ROWNO, ur.role_code AS "Role Name", TO_CHAR(NVL(ur.APPLY_END_DATE, TO_DATE('31/12/9999', 'DD/MM/YYYY')), 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS "Role End Date", u.USER_NAME AS "User ID", u.LOCAL_LANGUAGE_FULL_NAME AS "User Name", u.GRADE_TITLE_NAME AS "Title", u.POSITION_NAME AS "Position", em.fse_yn AS "FSE Flag", em.flsa_yn AS "Supporter Flag", CASE WHEN em.fse_yn = 'Y' OR em.flsa_yn = 'Y' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS "Test Result" from lgcom_user_role_n ur, vhr_mgr.lgcom_user_m u, emp_master em where 1 = 1 and ur.role_code = 'VN_ATT_FSE_USER' and ur.application_user_id = u.application_user_id and u.user_name = em.employee_number and NVL(ur.APPLY_END_DATE, TO_DATE('31/12/9999', 'DD/MM/YYYY')) > TO_DATE(#{timeAndAttendancdYyyymm}, 'DD/MM/YYYY')

INSERT INTO /* LGVATTCOMM.createExcelVNLineWorkPICUser */ XXLGE_EXPORT_INFO (SESSION_ID, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, SEQ_NO, CHARACTER_SET_NAME , ATTRIBUTE1, ATTRIBUTE2, ATTRIBUTE3, ATTRIBUTE4, ATTRIBUTE5 , ATTRIBUTE6, ATTRIBUTE7 ) SELECT #{sessionId} AS SESSION_ID , #{sessionUserId} AS CREATED_BY , SYSDATE AS CREATION_DATE , ROWNUM+1 AS ORDER_BY , 'KO16KSC5602' AS CHARACTER_SET_NAME , TO_CHAR(ROWNUM) AS ROWNO , 'Role Name' AS "Role Name" , 'Role End Date' AS "Role End Date" , 'User Name' AS "User Name" , 'Title' AS "Title" , 'Position' AS "Position" , 'Test Result' AS "Test Result" FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT #{sessionId} AS SESSION_ID , #{sessionUserId} AS CREATED_BY , SYSDATE AS CREATION_DATE , ROWNUM+1 AS ORDER_BY , 'KO16KSC5602' AS CHARACTER_SET_NAME , TO_CHAR(ROWNUM) AS ROWNO, ur.role_code AS "Role Name", to_char(NVL(ur.APPLY_END_DATE, TO_DATE('31/12/9999', 'DD/MM/YYYY')), 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS "Role End Date", u.LOCAL_LANGUAGE_FULL_NAME AS "User Name", u.GRADE_TITLE_NAME AS "Title", u.POSITION_NAME AS "Position", CASE WHEN TIME_ATTEND_CONTACT_USER_ID IS NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "Test Result" from lgcom_user_role_n ur, lgcom_user_m u, emp_master em, (select distinct (TIME_ATTEND_CONTACT_USER_ID) from tb_att_contract_n where NVL(EFFECTIVE_END_DATE, TO_DATE('31/12/9999', 'DD/MM/YYYY')) > TO_DATE(#{timeAndAttendancdYyyymm}, 'DD/MM/YYYY')) ac where u.user_name = em.employee_number and ur.application_user_id = u.application_user_id and u.user_name = ac.TIME_ATTEND_CONTACT_USER_ID (+) and em.STATUS != 'Terminate Assignment' and ROLE_CODE = 'VN_LINE_WORK_PIC_USER' and NVL(ur.APPLY_END_DATE, TO_DATE('31/12/9999', 'DD/MM/YYYY')) > TO_DATE(#{timeAndAttendancdYyyymm}, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
